# Sleep and Mood

## Why sleep matters
Poor sleep and low mood affect each other. Sleeping too little can make worry feel bigger, and worry can make it harder to fall asleep.

## Sleep hygiene tips
Keep a regular bedtime and wake time, even on weekends. Avoid caffeine in the afternoon and evening. Keep screens out of the bedroom, because blue light and notifications delay sleep.

Use the bed only for sleep. If you cannot fall asleep after about twenty minutes, get up, do something quiet in dim light, and return to bed when sleepy.

## When to seek help
If sleep problems last for several weeks and affect daily life, speak to a doctor.
